I am here in Mtwara, and my main food is this maize plot. The land is sandy and rains come in two seasons, but fertilizer is too costly for me — I will rely on what little manure I can gather from the goats and chickens. I cannot afford hybrid seed every year, so I will plant seed I saved from last harvest. My children help me weed with the hand-hoe, and only at planting and weeding time will I call a neighbour to help for a few days.
